tasks.short: Research park natural-history and environmental stories

steps.what: Find candidate natural-history and environmental stories in existing park archives using native place, subject and date filters
inputs: Existing catalogue entries maintained by park archive staff
outputs: Candidate original records and references in the park archive catalogue

steps.what: Read original story sources and environmental or natural-history records in full
outputs: Human understanding of original evidence and gaps

steps.what: Research the area's natural-history or environmental stories by comparing evidence, checking provenance and distinguishing supported facts from uncertain accounts
outputs: Human source assessment and supported story findings

steps.what: Write and check the actual working story-research note using native links to exact archive references
outputs: Completed research note with supported facts and uncertainty

steps.what: Save the research note in the existing workspace

tasks.design: Use native catalogue filters in the park archive, {OTHER}, to find original story sources. The naturalist reads and checks evidence, then writes the actual research note in {DOCS} with exact archive links.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated archive navigation and reference copying slow research without improving source understanding.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing catalogue metadata and native links can reduce those operations.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting accounts, uncertain provenance and unsupported environmental claims require original-source research.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish a compelling story from what the evidence actually supports.

ambition.what: Develop an additional evidence-supported interpretive story where actual source coverage permits.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 to inspect actual archive access and source rights

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native archive filters and exact reference links can reduce research navigation and copying without establishing historical or environmental truth.

assumptions: Representative archive-based research episode with an actual working research note. Archive staff produce existing catalogue entries in ordinary work; their effort remains unchanged. A new uncatalogued collection needs real cataloguing effort and cannot supply free searchable metadata.

s1 uses only existing place, subject and date fields; missing metadata returns to manual search. s2 retains full original-source reading, and s3 retains provenance and contradiction checking. No free summary, verified-fact feed or automatic story evaluation is assumed.

s4 separately counts actual research writing and all checking. It reduces only exact reference copying from sources actually verified in s2-s3. Native functionality comes first; existing filters and links yield no new gain.

This is research, not automatic public storytelling. Actual publication, public correspondence or delivery requires its own real work and authority. Ordinary save is ungated with no self-approval or saving. Do not invent an administrative report after research that produces no written finding.

Provisional shares ignore the prior. Gross 20*0.40+14*0.20=10.8; upkeep 2 leaves net 8.8. Retained s1-s4 labour is 88.2 already counted. Save share 1 is the schema minimum for negligible active effort, fully retained.
unknowns: Existing reference reuse and research-note practices
research_questions: Trace one researched park story back to original records and identify navigation separately from evidence assessment.

already_counted.description: Archive searching, full original reading, source assessment and actual research-note writing remain in s1-s4.

incremental.description: Maintain archive filters and reference links beyond existing source checking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound needs observed repeated searching and reference copying. If archive searching already uses the native filters, only 2.8 reference-copying points remain; 2 upkeep leaves 0.8. Missing catalogue metadata or already linked references require a lower re-estimate.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Compile and maintain official park photographic files

steps.what: Inspect actual park photographs and information files; verify provenance and capture the file inventory and exact metadata mapping
inputs: Actual photographs and information files produced by park photographers and information staff
outputs: Checked file inventory, source identifiers and explicit metadata mapping in the park asset archive

steps.what: Extract only existing embedded file metadata and exact file identifiers into the catalogue draft using the verified mapping
inputs: Checked file inventory and mapping from s1
outputs: Draft metadata rows with absent fields flagged

steps.what: Compare exact file hashes and identifiers against the current inventory; flag literal duplicates and missing metadata
outputs: Exact duplicate and missing-field list without deleting files

steps.what: Compile and maintain the official park photographic and information files by assessing subjects, rights, provenance, versions and actual catalogue descriptions
outputs: Human-curated file selections, metadata corrections and descriptions

steps.what: Check the completed catalogue entries against original files, rights evidence and current archive references
Save the completed entries in the same park asset archive

tasks.design: Use native metadata extraction and exact inventory comparison in the park asset archive, {OTHER}. The naturalist assesses rights and meaning against evidence in {DOCS}, writes actual descriptions and checks the completed entries before an ordinary archive save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing metadata is transcribed and exact file duplicates compared manually across photographic and information files.
tasks.enabler_now: Native metadata readers and hash comparisons can handle literal properties without interpreting photographs or rights.
tasks.still_hard: Subject identification, rights, provenance and meaningful version selection require evidence and human judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Keep an accurate official collection rather than treating file similarity as historical or rights equivalence.

ambition.what: Make a larger existing collection reliably discoverable for park program staff.

reach.task: Locate actual permitted photographs for interpretation
reach.learn: Which catalogue descriptions and rights evidence are reliable

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-4 to inspect actual archive access and rights records

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: embedded metadata extraction and exact hash or identifier comparison can assist file cataloguing without determining photographic subjects or rights.

assumptions: Representative maintenance of an existing digital collection where metadata transcription and literal inventory comparisons actually occur. Photographers and park information staff produce original files during existing work; archive staff produce the existing inventory. Focal provenance inspection, mapping and source checking are counted in s1.

s1 supplies every identifier, inventory key and mapping used in s2-s3. s2 reads only metadata actually embedded in the original files; it does not infer dates, locations, subjects or permissions. Missing data require manual investigation in s4.

Use native archive import and duplicate tools first. Existing metadata extraction and comparisons are today's baseline and yield no new gain. These shares describe real transcription and comparison work, not ordinary saving or a negligible file-copy click.

s3 only flags exact matches; no automatic deletion, rights judgement, public release or new access grant occurs. s4 and s5 retain actual description writing, correction and checking against originals. Physical digitisation or new photographer work must be counted separately if required.

Ordinary same-system save is ungated and adds no self-approval or saving. External sharing, publication, disposal or a restricted access change requires distinct actual authority and action if part of the workflow.

Provisional shares ignore the prior. Gross 15+20=35; upkeep 4 leaves net 31. Retained s1,s4,s5 labour is 64 already counted. Save share 1 is the integer minimum for negligible active effort, fully retained.
unknowns: Actual manual metadata and comparison workload
Embedded metadata coverage and existing native archive tools
research_questions: Inspect a real archive-maintenance batch and measure literal metadata transcription, duplicate checks and human description work separately.

already_counted.description: Source inventory and mapping, rights and description judgement, correction and final checking remain in s1,s4,s5.

incremental.description: Maintain metadata mappings and exact-comparison rules beyond ordinary archive curation.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound needs both actual metadata transcription and exact inventory checking. If native duplicate checking already covers s3, 15 metadata points remain eligible; 4 upkeep leaves 11. If both are already native, re-estimate below this range.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Interview specialists for park information programs

steps.what: Read actual specialist background and relevant park-program material using native subject and source filters
outputs: Verified interview context and source references

steps.what: Interview the actual specialist to obtain and develop data for park information programs, probe uncertainties and capture actual notes
outputs: Actual interview and contemporaneous notes with unresolved points

steps.what: Write and check the actual working interview-data note, distinguish specialist claims from corroborated facts and reuse exact existing source references
outputs: Completed working data note with attribution and uncertainty

steps.what: Save the working interview-data note in its existing workspace

tasks.design: Use native source filters and reference reuse in {DOCS} around the actual specialist interview. Keep questioning, note capture, attribution and interpretation with the naturalist; the working data note remains distinct from conversation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Background references are repeatedly found and recopied into actual interview-data notes.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document filters and reference links can reduce that repeated handling.
tasks.still_hard: Useful questioning, specialist uncertainty and distinguishing an account from established evidence remain human.
tasks.human_edge: Ask follow-up questions and preserve what the specialist actually said and qualified.

ambition.what: No additional specialist interview capacity is assumed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 to inspect actual interview-data access and attribution practices

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native source filters and exact reference links can assist interview preparation and working notes without replacing actual specialist questioning.

assumptions: Representative interview with an actual working data note used to develop park information. Existing source authors produce background materials in ordinary work; focal reading and actual interview preparation are counted in s1. Specialist participation remains actual unchanged work, not an automated evidence feed.

s2 counts all actual questioning and contemporaneous note capture. No free transcript, automatic recording or clean specialist-answer structure is assumed. s3 counts actual note writing and all attribution and uncertainty checks.

Only existing verified references from s1 are reused in s3. New claims are not automatically treated as true or publishable. Native functionality comes first; already linked references and existing filters carry no new gain.

The working note is the actual data-development record, not an invented administrative report after every conversation. If no such note exists, remove it and measure the actual data-capture work. No termly interview setup is charged to each conversation.

Saving the note is ordinary same-system work, ungated with no self-approval or saving. Actual quotation clearance, formal specialist approval, correspondence or public use requires its real work and authority if required; it is not silently completed by note saving.

Provisional shares ignore the prior. Gross 15*0.20+19*0.20=6.8; upkeep 2 leaves net 4.8. Retained s1-s3 labour is 92.2 already counted. Save share 1 is the integer minimum for negligible active effort, fully retained.
unknowns: Whether source references already reuse native links
research_questions: Inspect one actual specialist interview and trace how its data and qualifications enter the working park-information record.

already_counted.description: Background reading, actual interview and note capture, and working-data note writing and checking remain in s1-s3.

incremental.description: Maintain source filters and reference links beyond ordinary interview-note checking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound needs repeated background navigation and reference copying. If references already reuse native links, only 3 preparation-navigation points remain eligible; 2 upkeep leaves 1. Actual questioning and data interpretation remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Park interpretation teams using verified research
skills_to_grow: Archive provenance and exact metadata handling
Separate working records from public release
role.ambitious_version: A park naturalist who builds reliable information collections and interpretive evidence while retaining original-source research and direct specialist relationships.
